audit_items.title: Verify Invariant: Is EIP-7883 gas cost >= EIP-2565 gas cost for all inputs?
audit_items.scope_reason: EL (Execution Layer) component - Prysm is a Consensus Layer client. ModExp precompile gas calculations (EIP-7883, EIP-2565) are implemented in Execution Layer clients (Geth, Besu, Reth, etc.), not in Consensus Layer clients.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is ECDSA signature recovery correctly deriving sender addresses?
audit_items.scope_reason: EL (Execution Layer) component - Prysm is a Consensus Layer client. ECDSA signature recovery for transactions (recover_sender, secp256k1_recover) is implemented in Execution Layer clients. CL clients only verify BLS signatures for consensus-layer messages (attestations, blocks, etc.).
audit_items.notes: Prysm uses secp256k1 for p2p node identity (libp2p), not for transaction signature verification. Transaction validation is EL responsibility.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is the ECDSA r-component range validation enforced?
audit_items.scope_reason: EL (Execution Layer) component - Prysm is a Consensus Layer client. ECDSA signature validation for transactions (r-component range checks) is implemented in Execution Layer clients. CL clients do not process or validate transaction signatures.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is EIP-2 low-s normalization enforced?
audit_items.scope_reason: EL (Execution Layer) component - Prysm is a Consensus Layer client. EIP-2 low-s normalization for transaction signatures is implemented in Execution Layer clients. CL clients do not validate transaction malleability constraints.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Are transaction type signing hashes non-colliding?
audit_items.scope_reason: EL (Execution Layer) component - Prysm is a Consensus Layer client. Transaction type signing hashes (legacy, EIP-2718 typed transactions) are implemented in Execution Layer clients. CL clients do not process transaction signatures or validate signing hash uniqueness.

audit_items.title: Verify Conditional Scope: Pre-EIP-155 cross-chain replay vulnerability awareness
audit_items.scope_reason: EL (Execution Layer) component - Prysm is a Consensus Layer client. EIP-155 chain ID validation for transactions is implemented in Execution Layer clients. CL clients do not process transaction replay protection.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Does snapshot mechanism provide true deep-copy isolation?
audit_items.scope_reason: EL (Execution Layer) component - Prysm is a Consensus Layer client. Transaction-level state snapshots (begin_transaction, rollback_transaction, commit_transaction) for EVM execution are implemented in Execution Layer clients. CL clients do not manage EVM state or transaction atomicity.

audit_items.title: Is the snapshot count invariant maintained after begin_transaction?
audit_items.scope_reason: EL (Execution Layer) component - Prysm is a Consensus Layer client. Transaction snapshot lifecycle management (begin_transaction, snapshot count tracking) for EVM execution is implemented in Execution Layer clients. CL clients do not manage transaction-level state snapshots.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Does commit_transaction correctly decrement snapshot count?
audit_items.scope_reason: EL (Execution Layer) component - Prysm is a Consensus Layer client. Transaction snapshot commit/rollback logic for EVM execution is implemented in Execution Layer clients. CL clients do not manage transaction-level state snapshots or commit logic.

audit_items.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is created_accounts cleared only at outermost snapshot pop?
audit_items.scope_reason: EL (Execution Layer) component - Prysm is a Consensus Layer client. The created_accounts tracking for EIP-2200 gas accounting and EIP-6780 SELFDESTRUCT constraints is implemented in Execution Layer clients. CL clients do not track account creation or manage EVM-level state snapshots.
